data.explanation: This is your new legal protection insurance (Rechtsschutzversicherung) policy document, not a bill you need to act on now. Coverage starts on 1 February 2027, and there is a 3-month waiting period before you can use it, except for traffic-related legal matters. The first year's premium will be taken automatically from your account by direct debit when the policy starts. The contract renews automatically each year; if you ever want to cancel, it must be done 3 months before the end of an insurance year in text form, and the app will show you the relevant window when it gets closer. No immediate action is needed now.
